blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A bill seeking to double the minimum night shift differential for private-sector workers from the current 10 percent to 20 percent of their regular hourly wage has been filed by Sen. Loren Legarda. According to Legarda, the proposed increase would help recognize the sacrifices and health risks faced by workers whose schedules require them to work at night. Under Senate Bill No. 2585 filed on Nov. 4, the senator seeks to amend Article 86 of the Labor Code, which currently requires employers to pay employees a night shift differential of at least 10% of their regular wage for […]...
